source_identity.slice: mlx5e cyclic RQ, native-XDP linear single-buffer, ordinary page-backed order0, non-XSK; FIB single redirect to B or local UDP conditional PASS subset
source_identity.geometry: PAGE_SIZE stride, num_frags=1, mask=0 in selected cyclic/linear XDP slice; one packet position per RX allocation, repeated B must cross actual recycle/alloc
source_identity.authorization: T conditional on full actual mapping granule and later uses; S separate; actual trust/domain/shared-service deployment not established
source_identity.new_trace_headers: include/trace/events/page_pool.h, dma.h, xdp.h fixed at same commit; HTTP receipts in observation/

observed_native_statistics.meaning: null means not obtained, not zero or failed workload

L0.goal: B map occurrence/success within source/config episode
required_conditions: complete pool/page/config epochs and unambiguous B identity/call origin
map errors and early non-emitting paths kept separate
L0.does_not_prove: accepted frame, CQ, last reference, CPU duration or benefit

L1.missing_relation: frame/use ID+source allocation+target config/SQ and map call/result+driver accepted set
L1.existing_limit: redirect is enqueue result; devmap_xmit is bulk sent/drops/err without members

L2.goal: CQ/error/stop cleanup, frame/last-ref and source exit closure
L2.missing_relation: SQ/WQE/CQE epoch and frame mapping, actual reference return and service-specific valid outcome
L2.existing_limit: source release is pool exit marker, not final physical free or all frame CQ

required_provenance: running kernel commit/config and source-contract mapping
B netdev↔DMA device/config/domain/backend, no inference from ifindex or group alone
PAGE_SIZE/dma_addr width and actual event binary format
start/stop windows, clock/CPU and per-event enable/filter/loss statistics
raw record hashes and source; no data selected merely because favorable
pairing_rules: pool address/PFN/mem_id/dev_name are not permanent identities; hold/release counts global u32 can wrap
record allocation rounds and source ownership episodes separately; normal recycle does not change owner generation
unmap post event can lag backend free and a new same-IOVA map: even zero-loss timestamp order can be ambiguous
isolate unmatched/ambiguous and left/right-censored records; do not invent CQ/unmap or finite unseen tails
map failure, TX rejection, CQ error and stop cleanup are separate from valid work
no free translation from an O0 PFN trace to a candidate policy that changes recycle/allocation/Q

CPU_contract.full_boundary: driver call-site before/after single DMA frontend including inline wrapper and early returns; page API entry/return alone is explicitly narrower
CPU_contract.fields: operation ID, device/config, source/offset/size/dir/attrs, return/error, CPU/context/clock, preemption/IRQ and tracing overhead
CPU_contract.accounting: inclusive children counted once; map/unmap/sync, setup, lookup/prepare/fallback, source supply/retire, worker/Q and final tail separately covered
CPU_contract.not_CPU_duration: time between map and unmap post events; enqueue/CQ delay; invocation count converted with unknown cycles
CPU_contract.units: CPU execution/cycles with documented clock; physical bytes, IOVA, memory bandwidth and service/completion separate

conditional_bounds.source: r_try(g,B) <= actual RX alloc rounds in selected non-clone/non-broadcast/single-redirect slice; no nonzero reuse-rate lower bound from source alone
conditional_bounds.ideal_pair_opportunity: sum_g max(r_map_success(g)-1,0) only for complete valid source/config intersections, properly closed successful maps, T/granule legality and ignoring K/new costs; not CPU or online future input
conditional_bounds.CPU_direct: when only B map/unmap calls are removed and all remaining costs frozen, direct CPU removal <= measured M0_B; M0_B and C0 unknown; not a universal total-system or throughput bound
conditional_bounds.resource: actual per-policy S/P/C/Q union, metadata/PTE and IOVA separate; pool_size is returned-page ring capacity, not source page bound; K only bounds admitted association inventory/Q, not global RAM or delay

L0_geometry_inference.premises: proved one-packet-per-allocation selected geometry, single B redirect without clone/retry, verified map call origin and successful-result decoding, same complete source/config episode, no duplicate records
L0_geometry_inference.conclusion: two successful B maps imply at least one cross-recycle/reallocation B map occurrence; no new alloc/CQ probes are prerequisite for this coarse map-opportunity screen
L0_geometry_inference.does_not_prove: accepted/CQ/valid work count, CPU cost, natural frequency, finiteK net benefit or independent contribution
L0_geometry_inference.failures: other map origin, duplicate/missing epoch records, multibuffer or other geometry, pointer reuse, software map retry or broad replay context
